exact_output.claim_level: computed category-level Kirby-move evidence for multiplicity-nonfree SU(3)_3 / not arbitrary F-R link evaluator

hopf_star_projector_controls.projector_formula: central Omega_a around fixed leaves equals global_dimension times multiplicity of target simple current g_a in the fusion product

meridian_slide_coefficient_controls.interpretation: These are formal coefficient identities for a single arbitrary fixed-label knot value X_i; they cover the meridian-slide link classes used in the SU(2)_6 stress suite without requiring a SU(3)_3 knot-polynomial backend.

nontrivial_over_nontrivial_coefficient_c.interpretation: These are formal coefficient identities for arbitrary fixed-label nontrivial knot values X_i and Y_j.  Fusion multiplicities, including the 2*(1,1) term in (1,1)*(1,1), enter the after coefficient.

exact_output.not_scope: arbitrary SU(3)_3 link polynomial, arbitrary planar diagram, full F/R tensor-network evaluator, dotted/special links, closed 4-manifold normalization, or exotic-pair computation
exact_output.scope: modular controls, Omega projector controls, Hopf-star fusion controls, meridian-slide coefficient identities, and nontrivial-over-nontrivial parallel-copy fusion coefficient identities

notes: This is a SU(3)_3 category-level multiplicity stress suite.
It proves coefficient identities for the Kirby-move classes used so far, not arbitrary link polynomials.
